notes_for_us: This prompt and the F1 one in this batch are the same request - build a real-world thing to its real specification - and the skills answer them completely differently. Sports has a note saying regulation specs are known quantities and should be placed parametrically. Racing has no equivalent, and its P6 generates its own route, so 'an NBA court' works and 'the actual Silverstone' cannot. The Sports note is the one worth generalising.

The prompt begins 'make the court', which only makes sense as a follow-up to something. Nothing in layout-intake handles a prompt that edits an existing build rather than describing a new one, so it was treated as a fresh build and the reference to prior context was recorded as a question.

Court markings had to go in as marker-distance, which is worded for yard lines and outfield distances. On a basketball court the markings are the court, not a progress cue, and they are the single most important thing the image model has to get right.
